project_type: Next.js App Router + Electron desktop markdown note-taking app (Obsidian clone)
build_system: Bun (package manager), Next.js build system. Lint via ESLint.
test_framework: No test framework currently set up. Validation via lint + build.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'bun run lint' and confirm zero errors. 2. Run 'bun run build' and confirm build succeeds.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - can install packages. Bun at /root/.local/share/mise/installs/bun/latest/bin. No test framework exists - rely on lint + build for verification.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow existing code patterns: Zustand stores, shadcn/radix UI, Tailwind CSS v4, CodeMirror 6 for editor.
key_patterns: Zustand stores with immutable updates, pure workspace tree ops in lib/workspace/tree.ts, CodeMirror mount-once pattern with imperative doc swap, demo vault seed data in lib/vault/demo.ts, link index for backlinks/graph, inverted index for search, useBuiltinCommands hook for command registration
directory_structure: src/components/vault/ - shell UI (sidebars, ribbon, file tree, status bar); src/components/workspace/ - split panes and leaf rendering; src/components/editor/ - CodeMirror editor and panels; src/components/graph/ - graph visualization; src/components/canvas/ - infinite canvas; src/components/automation/ - command palette, hover preview; src/components/search/ - full-text search; src/components/settings/ - settings modal; src/store/ - Zustand stores; src/lib/ - pure logic modules
